title: The Inference Engineering Masterclass — Philip Kiely & Ali Taha, Baseten
content: Baseten just raised a $13B Series F and is now one of the leading kings of inference engineering. We go into everything you need to know for autoregressive and diffusion engineering.
summary_zh: Baseten 完成 130 亿美元估值的 F 轮融资后，其团队 Philip Kiely 与 Ali Taha 在这期播客中系统讲解推理工程（inference engineering）的全貌，涵盖自回归模型与扩散模型两条技术路线的部署与优化实践。对于需要自建或调优 LLM 推理服务的工程师，是一份关于吞吐、延迟、成本权衡的体系化知识梳理。与 Claude Code 日常使用关联较弱，更偏底层基础设施层面。

content: Programming with Claude Code will soon require even less human oversight.

title: GitHub Models is now retired
content: GitHub Models is now retired I missed this news until today, when the GitHub Actions run for my simonw/research repository failed with this error message: GitHub Models is temporarily unavailable as part of a scheduled retirement brownout. That message is already stale, because the retirement has been completed. GitHub Models was an odd-shaped duck. GitHub provided a model playground tool and a unified API across a bunch of different LLM providers, with the biggest benefit being that code running in GitHub Actions could use the GitHub API key already present in that environment to execute prompts. This made it easy to build things that fit GitHub Next's Continuous AI concept. GitHub didn't share the reason behind the shutdown, but my bet is that it fits the pattern where coding agent patterns made it prohibitively expensive to offer free or subsidized tokens. summary_zh: GitHub Models 服务已正式停用，Simon Willison 因其 GitHub Actions 工作流报错才发现此事。该服务曾提供统一的多厂商 LLM API，最大价值在于 Actions 环境可直接复用内置 GitHub token 调用模型，支撑了 GitHub Next 的 Continuous AI 理念。对依赖该服务做 CI 内 AI 自动化的开发者，需尽快迁移到其他模型提供方。

title: fix(plan-canvas): deliver browser chat to the agent every time (#2739)
content:
fix(plan-canvas): deliver browser chat to the agent every time (#2739)

Feedback sent from the canvas only reached an agent through a live
/api/await long poll. When a turn ended with no await parked,
queueFeedback wrote the message to sessions.json and nothing ever
consumed it, so sending appeared to do nothing at all. The presence pill
made it worse: workingKeys had no expiry and the feedback handler never
broadcast presence, so it froze on "agent working" while nobody was
listening.

Delivery:
- Add the stop:plan-canvas-pending hook. It drains undelivered feedback
  and blocks the Stop, handing the messages to the agent, so a canvas
  message lands even when no await is running. Scoped to sessions under
  cwd so parallel agents cannot swallow each other's feedback; set
  ECC_PLAN_CANVAS_STOP_SCOPE=all to widen. Honors stop_hook_active and
  fails open on every error path.
- run-with-flags.js did not await a hook's run(), so any async hook
  silently degraded to pass-through. Fixed;
author: haelyra
summary_zh: 这是 everything-claude-code 项目的一个 bug 修复提交，解决 plan-canvas 浏览器聊天反馈无法可靠送达 agent 的问题。核心方案是新增 stop:plan-canvas-pending 钩子，在 Stop 事件时排空未投递的反馈并阻塞停止，同时按 cwd 作用域隔离并行 agent 的消息，并修复了 presence 状态卡在「agent working」的问题。对理解 Claude Code Hooks 机制（Stop hook 阻塞与消息注入）有一定参考价值。
